session_a.query: What is the capital buffer requirement for Category 2 institutions under the March 2026 OSFI update?

facts.fact: OSFI Guideline B-20 (March 2026 revision), Section 4.1 sets the capital buffer for Category 2 institutions at 2.5% of risk-weighted assets, effective Q2 2026.
The 2.5% Category 2 buffer supersedes the previous 2.0% requirement from the 2023 revision.

session_b.query: What capital buffer percentage applies to Tier 2 institutions per recent OSFI guidance?

retrieved_facts.memory: OSFI Guideline B-20 (March 2026 revision) sets the Category 2 capital buffer at 2.5% of risk-weighted assets, effective Q2 2026.

session_b.answer: Tier 2 (Category 2) institutions must hold a 2.5% capital buffer of risk-weighted assets under OSFI B-20 (March 2026), effective Q2 2026 — superseding the prior 2.0%. [VERIFIED, source: osfi_b20_2026.pdf, B-20 s.4.1, p.34]
